title-group.article-title: Two invented promoter mutations change reporter activity

abstract.p: We describe invented reporter experiments on the promoter mutations −58A>C and −70C>T for software tests.

sec.title: Reporter assays
sec.p: In a luciferase reporter in K562 cells, the −58A>C mutant construct gave twofold lower activity than the wild-type construct. The promoter was active in K562 cells and inactive in HepG2 cells.
In the same luciferase reporter, the −70C>T mutant construct gave threefold higher activity than the wild-type construct.

sec.title: A second reporter
sec.p: In a second luciferase reporter in K562 cells, the mutant construct gave lower activity than the wild-type construct.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Our invented results suggest that −58A>C lowers promoter activity.
